endorsements.quote: He underscored the necessity for developing legal frameworks that account for the shared responsibilities among AI developers, healthcare providers, and regulatory bodies.

Highlighting the importance of considering human oversight in healthcare AI applications, Dr. Price argued that AI should augment but not replace the nuanced decision-making of healthcare providers when expert providers are available.

unlisted_practices: Ensure voice AI technology does not exacerbate existing disparities in healthcare access and quality.
Develop AI governance and regulatory frameworks that adapt to technological advancement and to variability in AI performance across healthcare settings.
Continue dialogue among technologists, legal experts, ethicists, and healthcare providers to ensure AI tools are developed and deployed ethically and effectively.
Design AI systems to be context-aware and test them across diverse environments and equipment types.

screen.reason: This record summarizes keynote speeches from a symposium focusing on ethical, regulatory, and governance frameworks for voice AI in healthcare.
